Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

alphabet — the letters of a language in order. Example: The English alphabet has 26 letters.
letter — one sign of the alphabet. Example: The first letter is A.
spell — to say the letters of a word. Example: Spell your surname, please.
vowel — the letters a, e, i, o, u. Example: A is a vowel.
consonant — a letter that is not a vowel. Example: B is a consonant.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How do you spell your name?
• Can you repeat that, please?
• It is B as in Bravo.
• Double L.
• At sign, then the domain.
